sealed_criteria.new_control: At least two executed positive renewals and two executed negative/reuse decisions, with at least two useful prior-certificate uses.
sealed_criteria.functional_tradeoff: At least inherited useful deliveries minus2 over same16opportunities, and >=25percent fewer fresh FI operations. Report all other measures separately; no composite reward rewrite.
sealed_criteria.history: At least one Q1 reference change and a later changed use under common frozen codec; compare nonfailure/yoked and do not require exclusive real-feedback superiority.
sealed_criteria.core: At least10/12 inherited uses, including correct luma/nara/alfa, both nonzero comparisons and actual two-step arithmetic result transport. Any missing critical use blocks promotion.
sealed_criteria.continuation: Complete coherent save/reopen, a useful later new-habitat interaction, decisive Native acquisition replay and public material use before final closure.

limitations: Native STATE/preview/fixed phase and codec are comparable, not the entire global landscape.
This is documentary analysis of one history. Contingency specificity requires actual controls; no real>yoked claim is made.
Prepared environmental certificate and fixed Q2 continuation map are not Native learned memory or a discovered plan.
All original changes after nonfailure are retained; the bank is not explained as a host-written negative-value table.
